tldr: 加權指數前一交易日收 47,041 點、漲 490 點（+1.05%），台積電走穩帶動大盤。
台積電全球同步興建近 20 座廠，反映 AI 需求為 30 年來罕見的擴張速度。
玉山金完成併購三商壽、前八月獲利創同期新高，正式邁入金控 2.0。
金管會針對壽險型金控推出資本適足暫行減壓措施，為接軌新清償制度鋪路。
月配息 ETF 戰場從高股息擴及債券與主動式產品，定期定額買氣延續。

items.title_zh: 權值股回神 台股站回 47,000 點
items.title_en: TAIEX firms above 47,000 as heavyweights rebound
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數前一交易日收在 47,041.21 點，上漲 490.08 點、漲幅 1.05%，權值股領軍反彈。台積電（2330）上漲約 1.0%、來到每股約 2,435 元，撐住大盤。近期震盪後市場情緒轉穩，AI 相關族群與金融股同為當日支撐，市場靜待本週密集的經濟數據與法說行情。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX closed the prior session at 47,041.21, up 490.08 points or 1.05%, as index heavyweights led a rebound. TSMC (2330) advanced about 1.0% to around NT$2,435, underpinning the broader market. The move steadied sentiment after recent volatility, with AI-related names and financials among the day's supports ahead of a data-heavy week.

items.title_zh: 8 月營收速報 AI 鏈成長強勁
items.title_en: August revenue reports flag strong AI-linked growth
items.summary_zh: 最新月營收揭露中，約 15 家資本額逾 50 億元的大型企業已公布 8 月營收，其中約 9 家年增率逾 25%、僅 1 家年減逾 20%。記憶體廠威剛單月合併營收約 189 億元、創歷史新高並連 6 個月刷新紀錄，顯示 AI 伺服器與 DRAM 需求持續推升本波獲利循環。
items.summary_en: In the latest monthly revenue disclosures, roughly 15 large-cap firms (capital of NT$5bn or more) had reported August sales, with about nine posting year-on-year growth above 25% and only one down more than 20%. Memory maker ADATA logged a record monthly revenue near NT$18.9bn, its sixth straight record, signalling that AI-server and DRAM demand continues to drive the earnings cycle.

items.title_zh: AI 需求加速 台積電全球興建近 20 座廠
items.title_en: TSMC building nearly 20 fabs as AI demand accelerates
items.summary_zh: 台積電高層指出，AI 需求成長速度為 30 年來罕見。公司估算 2026 年為滿足客戶所需採購的設備，已上修至原估值約 1.9 倍；目前全球同步興建約 20 座晶圓廠——台灣約 13 座、海外另有 5 至 6 座，遠高於過去同期的 4 至 5 座，但先進製程與封裝產能仍追不上需求。
items.summary_en: TSMC executives say AI demand is growing at a pace unseen in 30 years. The chipmaker's estimated 2026 equipment purchases have been revised up to about 1.9x an earlier baseline, and it is now constructing roughly 20 fabs globally — around 13 in Taiwan plus five to six overseas, versus four to five in comparable past periods — yet capacity still lags demand for advanced nodes and packaging.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 威剛示警 DRAM 缺貨 合約價恐再漲四成
items.title_en: ADATA warns DRAM shortage may lift contract prices 40%
items.summary_zh: 記憶體模組廠威剛表示，全球三大 DRAM 原廠庫存已降至警戒線，僅約 3 至 5 週供應量；預估至 2026 年第二季，PC 用 DRAM 合約價將再大漲約 40%。公司已把第三季備貨拉高至逾 500 億元，並將出貨組合轉向 AI 伺服器、高容量 DRAM 與企業級儲存，卡位這波供不應求行情。
items.summary_en: Memory-module maker ADATA said the world's top three DRAM makers have run inventories down to a warning line of only about three to five weeks of supply. It expects PC DRAM contract prices to jump around 40% again by the second quarter of 2026, and has lifted third-quarter inventory build to over NT$50bn while shifting its mix toward AI servers, high-capacity DRAM and enterprise storage.

items.title_zh: 玉山金完成併購三商壽 獲利創同期新高
items.title_en: E.Sun FHC completes Mercuries Life merger, posts record profit
items.summary_zh: 玉山金控以股份轉換方式完成併購三商壽（9 月 1 日生效），並參與 160 億元現金增資，正式邁入具壽險版圖的「金控 2.0」。累計前八月稅後純益約 280.4 億元，創歷年同期新高、年增 20.3%，每股稅後盈餘 1.73 元，銀行與證券子公司為主要獲利引擎。
items.summary_en: E.Sun Financial Holdings has completed its share-swap acquisition of Mercuries Life (effective Sept 1), including participation in a NT$16bn cash injection, moving the group into a "FHC 2.0" phase with a life-insurance arm. Cumulative net profit for the first eight months reached about NT$28.04bn, a record for the period and up 20.3% year-on-year, with EPS of NT$1.73 as banking and securities units drove earnings.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁資本規定 助壽險金控接軌新制
items.title_en: Regulator eases capital rules ahead of new solvency regime
items.summary_zh: 為配合保險業接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS）與 IFRS 17，金管會給予監理彈性，讓 8 家壽險型金控資本減壓，並允許 11 家保險型金控延後 1 個月申報資本適足率。措施包括資本適足率匯率採均價制度、放寬保單責任準備金計提基礎等，以協助業者平順過渡。
items.summary_en: Ahead of insurers adopting Taiwan's new-generation solvency system (TIS) and IFRS 17, the FSC has offered supervisory flexibility that eases capital pressure for eight life-insurance-heavy financial holding companies and lets eleven insurance-type FHCs defer capital-adequacy filing by a month. Measures include an averaged FX basis for capital ratios and looser reserving bases to smooth the transition.

items.title_zh: 月配息 ETF 戰場擴大 不再只有高股息
items.summary_zh: 台灣散戶市場中，月配息 ETF 已不再是高股息股票型基金的專利，債券 ETF、投資級與非投等債、主動式 ETF 陸續加入月配行列。0056、00878、00919、00929、00940 等仍是高股息族群主角；定期定額買盤持續穩定流入，反映投資人偏好穩定現金流、又不想花太多時間選股的心理需求。
items.summary_en: In Taiwan's retail market, monthly-dividend ETFs are no longer the preserve of high-yield equity funds: bond ETFs, investment-grade and non-investment-grade credit, and active ETFs have joined the monthly-payout arena. Popular tickers such as 0056, 00878, 00919, 00929 and 00940 remain core high-yield picks, while regular fixed-amount investing keeps drawing steady inflows from cash-flow-focused savers.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 保險業深耕高資產財管業務
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產客群快速成長，財富管理需求橫跨信託、海外債、基金、ETF、結構型商品與財富傳承。延續 2020 年放寬服務資產逾 1 億元客戶條件的法規，目前約有 10 家壽險公司（含新光、南山、富邦人壽等）獲准辦理財富管理業務，擴大高資產客戶的商品與諮詢選擇。
items.summary_en: Wealth-management demand from Taiwan's growing high-net-worth segment continues to expand across trusts, offshore bonds, funds, ETFs, structured products and succession planning. Building on 2020 rules that eased conditions for serving clients with assets of NT$100mn or more, around ten life insurers — including Shin Kong, Nan Shan and Fubon Life — have been approved to run wealth-management businesses, widening product access for affluent clients.
